arg.name: world
arg.description: World SDF file name (resolved via GZ_SIM_RESOURCE_PATH)

arg.name: use_composition
arg.description: Use composable nodes for GzServer and bridge

arg.name: vehicle_sdf
arg.description: Model SDF file to spawn; empty spawns nothing

arg.name: vehicle_name
arg.description: Name the model is spawned under, which is also the name buoyancy registration uses

arg.name: vehicle_z
arg.description: Spawn position z [m]; 0 is the waterline

arg.name: bridge_config
arg.description: ros_gz_bridge YAML file. Replaces the default, which bridges only /clock, so a replacement should bridge /clock too

arg.name: buoyancy_enable
arg.description: Model or model::link name to register with the world's buoyancy system, for a model with no BuoyancyEnable plugin (e.g. blueboat::hull_displacement); separate several with spaces; empty registers nothing

node.name: spawn_vehicle
node.args: -name $(var vehicle_name) -file $(var vehicle_sdf) -x $(var vehicle_x) -y $(var vehicle_y) -z $(var vehicle_z) -Y $(var vehicle_yaw)
